title: Mobile menu page for QR codes
when: The user wants a phone first menu that customers open from a QR code at the table.
inputs: menu items with prices and categories
prompt:
Goal: A tiny, instant loading menu for phones with category jumps and clear prices.
Steps:
1. One HTML file with inline CSS, under 100 KB, no external fonts.
2. Sticky category bar with anchor links that scrolls sideways if long.
3. Items: name, short description, price aligned right, dietary labels as text.
4. Large tap targets and text at least 16 px.
5. Optional language switch as links to sections or separate files.
Quality bar:
- Readable in bright light: strong contrast.
- Loads on weak connections.
- Prices are easy to compare.
Pitfalls:
- PDF menus that need zooming.
- Photos that make the page heavy.
- Category bar that hides headings.
Verify:
- [ ] Anchors match section ids.
- [ ] Contrast passes.
- [ ] No external assets.
- [ ] Viewport present.
Output: menu.html with inline styles.

examples.input: cardápio digital para QR code do bar
examples.output: sticky categories Drinks, Food, Desserts, items with prices, vegan labels
